title: World Series Champion Bob Boone Dies at 78
summary: Bob Boone, a World Series champion and a member of Major League Baseball's first three-generation family of players, has died at the age of 78. Boone was a catcher for the Philadelphia Phillies and was part of the 1980 World Series-winning team.
title_hi: वर्ल्ड सीरीज चैंपियन बॉब बून का 78 वर्ष की आयु में निधन
summary_hi: वर्ल्ड सीरीज चैंपियन और मेजर लीग बेसबॉल के पहले तीन-पीढ़ी के खिलाड़ियों के परिवार के सदस्य बॉब बून का 78 वर्ष की आयु में निधन हो गया है। बून फिलाडेल्फिया फिलीज के लिए कैचर थे और 1980 की वर्ल्ड सीरीज जीतने वाली टीम का हिस्सा थे।

center: Reported Bob Boone's death at 78, highlighting his role as a former Philadelphia Phillies catcher and 1980 World Series champion.
right: Emphasized Bob Boone's death at 78, noting his status as a World Series champion and his distinction as part of MLB's first three-generation family of players.
